note: Evaluation only; agents receive only goal, requirements and the browser. Freeze by committing before the scored batch.
model_notes: Prices checked 2026-10-31 on the OpenRouter endpoints API (US$/M in/out): Gemini 0.50/3.00, DeepSeek about 0.09/0.18 (varies by provider), GPT-5 Nano 0.05/0.40. All accept reasoning and response_format. GPT-5 Nano lists no temperature parameter, so temperature 0 is not applied to it. Provider routing is left to OpenRouter.
unusable_rule: A run is unusable if it has a harness error, no successful model call, or at least half its calls failed or were rejected. Two consecutive unusable runs stop that model; its remaining cells are reported as not run.

todomvc.goal: Add a todo named 'FlowLens milk', mark it completed, then open the Active and Completed filters. Finish when you have seen them.
requirements: P1. A todo typed into the input and submitted appears in the list.
P2. Submitting an empty todo must not add an item to the list.
P3. The Completed filter shows only completed todos, and the Active filter shows only todos that are not completed.
todomvc.limitations: Todos live in client-side storage, so a fresh browser context starts empty. The site itself is shared, and FlowLens may not treat its input as a form.

the-internet.goal: From the home page, open the Form Authentication, Checkboxes and Dropdown pages. Do not open any other example. Finish when you have seen them.
requirements: H1. Submitting the login form with a wrong password must be rejected with an error message, and the secure area is not shown.
H2. Submitting the login form with the username and password printed on the login page opens the secure area.
the-internet.limitations: Shared public server with no workspace isolation; external page content is not controlled. Other example pages are reachable, so explorers may leave the journey. No ad blocker is used.
